subject: general
question: Article 19(d) of the Constitution of India deals with the ______.

options.text: right to move freely throughout the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is the __**right to move freely throughout the territory of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 19** of the India Constitution defines that:

** All citizens shall have the right—**

 (a) to freedom of speech and expression

 (b) to assemble peaceably and without arms

 (c) to form associations or unions

 **(d)** **to move freely throughout the territory of India**

 (e) to reside and settle in any part of the territory of India

 (f) to practice any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade, or business.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution guarantees **six fundamental rights** to Indian citizens as follows: (i) right to equality, (ii) **right to freedom**, (iii) right against exploitation, (iv) right to freedom of religion, (v) cultural and educational rights, and (vi) right to constitutional remedies.
 
• Fundamental Rights are defined from **Article 12 to Article 35.**
 
• Fundamental Rights come under **Part III** of the Indian Constitution. 
 
• These are borrowed from **the USA**.
